## Notes

Hone is a proof of concept for finding Ruby performance optimisations that
matter, combining static analysis with runtime profiling. It was vibe-coded:
the idea was mine, and I directed an AI to build it without planning it or
reading what came back. I have not looked at the code, which is what
`unexamined` means, and I do not recommend depending on it.

It is abandoned. No one maintains it, and I do not expect to return to it.
